content: Database-per-service (Richardson microservices.io, canonical): the service's database is part of its implementation and cannot be accessed directly by other services; private-tables/schema/database-per-server are enforcement levels - create barriers (per-service DB credentials/grants) because without them developers bypass APIs. Benefits: loose coupling, polyglot persistence, independent scaling. Drawbacks handled by: Saga pattern for cross-service transactions, API Composition (gateway/service joins via API calls) or CQRS for cross-service queries; shared database documented as the anti-pattern alternative.
